79090-the-first-buckinghamshire-battalio.creator: Captain P. L. Wright, D.S.O., M.C.
79090-the-first-buckinghamshire-battalio.description: A book by Captain P. L. Wright, D.S.O., M.C.. Amongst the officers were many fine leaders of men, none more so than Lieutenant-Colonel Reynolds, who led the Battalion through most of the War. He was backed by many officers imbued with the same spirit and energy.

arxiv-2012-10793.title: On the Power of Localized Perceptron for Label-Optimal Learning of Halfspaces with Adversarial Noise
arxiv-2012-10793.creator: Jie Shen
arxiv-2012-10793.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Jie Shen. We study online active learning of homogeneous halfspaces in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} with adversarial noise where the overall probability of a noisy label is constrained to be at most ν \nu .

arxiv-2104-11611.title: Inclination-type resonance in two-planet systems 2019 Inclination-type resonance in two-planet systems – References
arxiv-2104-11611.creator: Sotiris Sotiriadis, Anne-Sophie Libert
arxiv-2104-11611.description: Abstract We investigate the inclination-growth mechanisms for two-planet systems during the late protoplanetary disc phase. In previous works, much attention has been directed to the inclination-type resonance, and it has been shown that it asks for high eccentricities to be acquired during the migration of the giant planets.

arxiv-2201-12234.title: Increasing the skill of short-term wind speed ensemble forecasts combining forecasts and observations via a new dynamic calibration Journal: Energy
arxiv-2201-12234.creator: Gabriele Casciaro, Francesco Ferrari, Daniele Lagomarsino Oneto, Andrea Lira-Loarca, Andrea Mazzino
arxiv-2201-12234.description: Abstract All numerical weather prediction models used for the wind industry need to produce their forecasts starting from the main synoptic hours 00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC, once the analysis becomes available. The six-hour latency time between two consecutive model runs calls for strategies to fill the gap by providing new accurate predictions having, at least, hourly frequency.

arxiv-2202-02247.title: Beam Management with Orientation and RSRP using Deep Learning for Beyond 5G Systems
arxiv-2202-02247.creator: Khuong N. Nguyen, Anum Ali, Jianhua Mo, Boon Loong Ng, Vutha Va, and Jianzhong Charlie Zhang
arxiv-2202-02247.description: Abstract Beam management (BM), i.e., the process of finding and maintaining a suitable transmit and receive beam pair, can be challenging, particularly in highly dynamic scenarios. Side-information, e.g., orientation, from on-board sensors can assist the user equipment (UE) BM. In this work, we use the orientation information coming from the inertial measurement unit (IMU) for effective BM.

arxiv-2311-07735.title: Assessing the potential impact of environmental land management schemes on emergent infection disease risks
arxiv-2311-07735.creator: Christopher J. Banks, Katherine Simpson, Nicholas Hanley, Rowland R. Kao
arxiv-2311-07735.description: Abstract Financial incentives are provided by governments to encourage the plantation of new woodland to increase habitat, biodiversity, carbon sequestration, and other economic benefits for landowners. Whilst these are largely positive effects, it is worth considering that greater biodiversity and presence of wildlife species in proximity to agricultural holdings may pose a risk of disease transmission between wildlife and livestock.

arxiv-2401-08741.title: Fixed Point Diffusion Models
arxiv-2401-08741.creator: Xingjian Bai, Luke Melas-Kyriazi
arxiv-2401-08741.description: Abstract We introduce the Fixed Point Diffusion Model (FPDM), a novel approach to image generation that integrates the concept of fixed point solving into the framework of diffusion-based generative modeling. Our approach embeds an implicit fixed point solving layer into the denoising network of a diffusion model, transforming the diffusion process into a sequence of closely-related fixed point problems.

arxiv-2407-08880.title: A class of stable nonlinear non-Hermitian skin modes
arxiv-2407-08880.creator: Hamed Ghaemi-Dizicheh
arxiv-2407-08880.description: Abstract The non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE) is a well-known phenomenon in open topological systems that causes a large number of eigenstates to become localized at the boundary. Although many aspects of its theory have been investigated in linear systems, this phenomenon remains novel in nonlinear models.

arxiv-2412-01544.title: Steady states of the spherically symmetric Vlasov-Poisson system as fixed points of a mass-preserving algorithm
arxiv-2412-01544.creator: Håkan Andréasson
arxiv-2412-01544.description: Abstract We give a new proof for the existence of spherically symmetric steady states to the Vlasov-Poisson system, following a strategy that has been used successfully to approximate axially symmetric solutions numerically, both to the Vlasov-Poisson system and to the Einstein-Vlasov system. There are several reasons why a mathematical analysis of this numerical scheme is important.

arxiv-2504-12966.title: Vision and Language Integration for Domain Generalization
arxiv-2504-12966.creator: Yanmei Wang, Xiyao Liu, Fupeng Chu, Zhi Han
arxiv-2504-12966.description: Abstract Domain generalization aims at training on source domains to uncover a domain-invariant feature space, allowing the model to perform robust generalization ability on unknown target domains. However, due to domain gaps, it is hard to find reliable common image feature space, and the reason for that is the lack of suitable basic units for images.

arxiv-2505-11405.title: ℰ ​ m ​ o ​ t ​ i ​ o ​ n ​ ℋ ​ a ​ l ​ l ​ u ​ c ​ e ​ r \mathcal{E}motion\mathcal{H}allucer : Evaluating Emotion Hallucinations in Multimodal Large Language Models
arxiv-2505-11405.creator: Bohao Xing, Xin Liu, Guoying Zhao, Chengyu Liu, Xiaolan Fu, Heikki Kälviäinen
arxiv-2505-11405.description: Abstract Emotion understanding is a critical yet challenging task. Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly enhanced their capabilities in this area. However, MLLMs often suffer from “hallucinations”, generating irrelevant or nonsensical content. To the best of our knowledge, despite the importance of this issue, there has been no dedicated effort to evaluate emotion-related hallucinations in MLLMs.

arxiv-2509-22634.title: Limitations of detecting structural changes and time-reversal symmetry breaking in scanning tunneling microscopy experiments
arxiv-2509-22634.creator: Christopher Candelora, Ilija Zeljkovic
arxiv-2509-22634.description: Abstract The family of kagome superconductors A V 3 Sb 5 ( A =K, Cs, Rb) is an exciting playground for investigating various density waves, unusual superconductivity and a surprising time-reversal symmetry breaking despite the absence of spin magnetism [ 1 , 2 ] .

arxiv-2602-24034.title: Sarnak’s Program for Erdős Sieves. Part II: Measure Systems and Applications
arxiv-2602-24034.creator: Francisco Araújo
arxiv-2602-24034.description: Abstract . This paper is the second part of a two-part article where we generalize Sarnak’s program to sets where we remove congruence classes modulo some infinite set ℬ \mathcal{B} of ideals of an étale ℚ − \mathbb{Q}- algebra K K , which we denote by Erdős sieves.

arxiv-2603-25803.creator: Spiros Baxevanakis spiros.baxevanakis@student.uva.nl, Platon Karageorgis platon.karageorgis@student.uva.nl, Ioannis Dravilas ioannis.dravilas@student.uva.nl, Konrad Szewczyk konrad.szewczyk@student.uva.nl

pmc-10575170.title: Dry Friction and Wear Behavior of Laser-Sintered Graphite/Carbon Fiber/Polyamide 12 Composite
pmc-10575170.creator: Abdelrasoul Gadelmoula, Saleh Ahmed Aldahash
pmc-10575170.description: Carbon fiber-reinforced polymers (CFRPs) are being used extensively in modern industries that require a high strength-to-weight ratio, such as aerospace, automotive, motorsport, and sports equipment. However, although reinforcement with carbon fibers improves the mechanical properties of polymers, this comes at the expense of abrasive wear resistance.

pmc-11351258.title: Multitarget Pharmacology of Sulfur–Nitrogen Heterocycles: Anticancer and Antioxidant Perspectives
pmc-11351258.creator: Aliki Drakontaeidi, Ilias Papanotas, Eleni Pontiki
pmc-11351258.description: Cancer and oxidative stress are interrelated, with reactive oxygen species (ROS) playing crucial roles in physiological processes and oncogenesis. Excessive ROS levels can induce DNA damage, leading to cancer, and disrupt antioxidant defenses, contributing to diseases like diabetes and cardiovascular disorders. Antioxidant mechanisms include enzymes and small molecules that mitigate ROS damage.

pmc-11433343.title: Biomarkers and Data Visualization of Insulin Resistance and Metabolic Syndrome: An Applicable Approach
pmc-11433343.creator: Christos Sotiropoulos, Nikolaos Giormezis, Vayianos Pertsas, Theodoros Tsirkas, Antonella Angiolillo
pmc-11433343.description: Type 2 diabetes, prediabetes, and insulin resistance (IR) are widespread yet often undetected in their early stages, contributing to a silent epidemic. Metabolic Syndrome (MetS) is also highly prevalent, increasing the chronic disease burden. Annual check-ups are inadequate for early detection due to conventional result formats that lack specific markers and comprehensive visualization.

pmc-12410493.title: Unveiling rare metastasis in prostate cancer: The role of PSMA-PET and MRI in detecting penile involvement – A case report and literature review
pmc-12410493.creator: Léon Groenhoff, Gaetano Federico Fortuna, Pietro Costantini, Anna Colarieti, Silvia Attanasio, Alessandro Carriero
pmc-12410493.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The aim of this study is to report a case of penile metastasis from prostate carcinoma, as it represents a very rare occurrence that clinicians should be aware of.We report a case of a 68-year-old patient affected by prostate cancer who has performed a PSMA-PET after radical prostatectomy for PSA elevation, which revealed a suspected uptake in the corpora cavernosa and corpora spongiosum, followed by multiparametric MRI examination with focus on penile involvement.

pmc-12661352.title: A head-to-head comparison of sextant-systematic biopsy vs. extended-systematic biopsy for prostate cancer diagnosis in the era of MRI-targeted biopsy: SEXTANT-PRO non-inferiority randomized clinical trial
pmc-12661352.creator: Ruiyi Deng, Jiaheng Shang, Jingyun Wu, Shaojuan Tian, Derun Li, Qi Shen, Shuai Hu, Meixia Shang, Jianhui Qiu, Jingcheng Zhou, Lin Cai, Kan Gong, Yi Liu
pmc-12661352.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). SummaryBackgroundIn recent years, combined MRI-targeted biopsy (TB) and 12-core extended systematic biopsy (SB) (TB + 12SB) has been recommended for biopsy-naïve patients with MRI-visible lesions for prostate cancer (PCa) diagnosis. However, extended biopsy increases complication burden and healthcare expenditure.

pmc-12692747.title: An Editorial for Mechanical Performance and Microstructural Characterization of Light Alloys (2nd Edition)
pmc-12692747.creator: Qinghuan Huo
pmc-12692747.description: lways demonstrate a much lower strength compared with their base materials, owing to their high stack fault energy and hard recrystallization potential [7,8]. Magnesium and its alloys, as the lightest structural materials, present different drawbacks, displaying poor tensile ductility and corrosion resistance [9,10,11].

pmc-12764828.title: Diagnostic performance of real-time artificial intelligence using deep learning analysis of endoscopic ultrasound videos for gallbladder polypoid lesions
pmc-12764828.creator: Young Hoon Choi, Jun Young Park, See Young Lee, Jae Hee Cho, Young Jae Kim, Kwang Gi Kim, Sung Ill Jang
pmc-12764828.description: Endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) is accurate for diagnosing gallbladder (GB) polyps but is limited by subjective interpretation and operator expertise. Although artificial intelligence (AI) has been applied to still EUS images of GB polyps, its application to EUS videos, which provide richer diagnostic data, remains unexplored.

pmc-13044318.title: Use of a synthetic antimicrobial peptide (PA-13) alone or in combination with reduced gentamicin levels to control Escherichia coli contamination in stored boar semen
pmc-13044318.creator: Krittika Keeratikunakorn, Panida Chanapiwat, Ratchaneewan Aunpad, Natharin Ngamwongsatit, Kampon Kaeoket
pmc-13044318.description: Background and Aim:Bacterial contamination during liquid storage of boar semen negatively affects sperm quality and fertility outcomes, necessitating the routine use of antibiotics in semen extenders. However, increasing concerns regarding antimicrobial resistance have encouraged the development of alternative antimicrobial strategies. Synthetic antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) have demonstrated broad-spectrum antibacterial activity and may serve as potential substitutes or adjuncts to conventional antibiotics.

pmc-13214274.title: Cryptococcus neoformans invasion of the orbital compartment and periocular spaces following intracerebral infection in mice
pmc-13214274.creator: Melissa E Munzen, Vanessa Enriquez, Claudia L Charles-Niño, Marta Reguera-Gomez, Karina Alviña, Michael R Dores, Luis R Martinez
pmc-13214274.description: SummaryCryptococcus neoformans is an encapsulated and neurotropic fungus known for causing life-threatening meningoencephalitis in immunocompromised individuals. We used a murine intracerebral infection model to study C. neoformans brain infection and microglia-fungal interactions. Mice infected with the C. neoformans H99 strain exhibited hydrocephalus, cryptococcoma formation, and significantly higher brain fungal burden than the acapsular cap59 strain at 7-days post infection (dpi).

pmc-2375021.title: The DAVID Gene Functional Classification Tool: a novel biological module-centric algorithm to functionally analyze large gene lists
pmc-2375021.creator: Da Wei Huang, Brad T Sherman, Qina Tan et al.
pmc-2375021.description: Peer-reviewed research article (PubMed Central). The DAVID gene functional classification tool uses a novel fuzzy clustering algorithm to condense a list of genes or associated biological terms into organized classes of related genes or biology, called biological modules.
